action: const express = require('express'); const multer = require('multer'); const { execFile } = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); const fs = require('fs'); const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid'); const app = express(); const upload = multer({ dest: 'uploads/' }); app.post('/create-gif', upload.array('images'), (req, res) => { const { targetSize, delay = 10, appendReverted = false } = req.body; const files = req.files; if (!files || files.length === 0) { return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No images uploaded' }); } if (!targetSize) { return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Target size is required' }); } const outputFileName = `output-${uuidv4()}.gif`; const filePaths = files.map(file => file.path); const args = ['-delay', delay.toString(), '-resize', targetSize, ...filePaths]; if (appendReverted === 'true' || appendReverted === true) { args.push(...filePaths.reverse()); } args.push(outputFileName); execFile('convert', args, (error) => { // Clean up uploaded files filePaths.forEach(filePath => fs.unlinkSync(filePath)); if (error) { return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to create GIF' }); } res.sendFile(path.resolve(outputFileName), (err) => { fs.unlinkSync(outputFileName); // Clean up the generated GIF if (err) { res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to send GIF' }); } }); }); }); app.listen(5000, '0.0.0.0', () => { console.log('Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:5000'); });
